items.translation: During the first class, the boy took notes and listened to the teacher.

source.title: El bolso perdido — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.translation: At the end of class, he realized he had forgotten his backpack.

source.name: youtube
source.title: El bolso perdido — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.translation: He rushed to look for it, but he couldn't find it anywhere.

source.title: El bolso perdido — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

source.title: El bolso perdido — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.translation: The boy thanked the teacher and ran out of the classroom.

items.translation: In the hallway, he saw his friends and showed them his backpack.

source.name: youtube
source.title: El bolso perdido — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.text: Os amigos o parabenizaram e disseram que ele teve muita sorte.
items.translation: His friends congratulated him and said he was very lucky.

source.name: youtube
source.title: El bolso perdido — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.translation: His mom told him he should be more careful.
